role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 巨牙海民总是斗志昂扬。他可以创造一道碎冰之墙马上困住敌人，召集友军进入巨大的雪球向敌人滚去，近身后再祭出招牌的淘汰之拳。
hero_summary_en: Tusk is always eager to start a fight. Able to instantly corner an enemy with a wall of ice shards, he gathers with his allies and rolls into enemies inside of a massive snowball, bringing him in range to land his signature knockout punch.

abilities.name: tusk_ice_shards
abilities.description_zh: 巨牙海民将数块寒冰碎片压缩成蕴含冰冻能量的冰球，对所有接触到冰球的敌人造成伤害。冰球到达目标地点时会产生一个障碍物，持续%shard_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 将创造不可通行的障碍。

abilities.name: tusk_snowball
abilities.description_zh: 巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被眩晕并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和眩晕时间都会得到提升。
abilities.description_en: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
notes_zh: 雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。
notes_en: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.

abilities.name: tusk_tag_team
abilities.description_zh: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续%debuff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。
notes_en: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.

abilities.name: tusk_drinking_buddies
abilities.description_zh: 巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。
abilities.description_en: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
notes_zh: 如果巨牙海民和目标友军相距在%min_distance%距离以内，就不会拉动他们。
notes_en: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.

abilities.name: tusk_walrus_kick
abilities.description_zh: 将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成眩晕，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域%search_radius%范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少%creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.

abilities.name: tusk_walrus_punch
abilities.description_zh: 巨牙海民为他强力的海象神拳做好准备，下一次攻击将会造成额外伤害并暴击，同时将目标打到半空中。
abilities.description_en: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
notes_zh: 海象神拳！拥有克敌机先效果。

abilities.name: tusk_bitter_chill
abilities.description_zh: 被动降低%radius%范围内所有敌方英雄的攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a %radius% unit radius.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_tusk_shard_dps
talents_raw.name_loc: Ice Shards slow by {s:bonus_aghs_shard_move_slow}% and deal {s:bonus_aghs_shard_damage} DPS
talents_raw.desc_loc: Applies to enemies trapped inside the Ice Shards

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_tusk_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Walrus Punch gains a chance to be triggered on normal attacks, independent of mana cost or cooldown.
